kind: own local official pg_duckdb reference, normal owner aggregation; not Bex/CNPG candidate acceptance

steps.label: catalog
command: SELECT jsonb_build_object('version',current_setting('server_version_num'),'encoding',current_setting('server_encoding'),'available',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',name,'default',default_version,'installed',installed_version) ORDER BY name) FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name IN('pg_duckdb','vector','pg_stat_statements','hstore','plpgsql')),'[]'::jsonb),'own_schema_exists',EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='qa444_local'))::text;

steps.label: enable
command: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_duckdb;

steps.label: postgres
command: BEGIN; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='20s'; CREATE SCHEMA qa444_local; SET LOCAL search_path=qa444_local,public; CREATE TABLE orders(region text NOT NULL,cents integer NOT NULL); INSERT INTO orders VALUES('north',1250),('north',725),('café:李',1999),('café:李',-499),('west',0); SELECT region,count(*) AS orders,sum(cents) AS cents FROM orders GROUP BY region; ROLLBACK;

steps.label: duckdb
command: BEGIN; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='20s'; CREATE SCHEMA qa444_local; SET LOCAL search_path=qa444_local,public; CREATE TABLE orders(region text NOT NULL,cents integer NOT NULL); INSERT INTO orders VALUES('north',1250),('north',725),('café:李',1999),('café:李',-499),('west',0); SET LOCAL duckdb.force_execution=true; SELECT region,count(*) AS orders,sum(cents) AS cents FROM orders GROUP BY region; EXPLAIN(ANALYZE TRUE,FORMAT JSON,COSTS OFF,TIMING OFF,SUMMARY OFF) SELECT region,count(*) AS orders,sum(cents) AS cents FROM orders GROUP BY region; ROLLBACK;
